The '''Begali Uprising''', also known as the '''Bengali Uprising''',<ref name="GAW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> was an uprising led by the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Begali]] against the [[Echani Command]], the female council that governed a confederation of six [[Echani/Legends|Echani]]-dominated planets known as the [[Six Sisters]] that began in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[1154 BBY]]. Begali was joined in revolt by the [[Thyrsian]]s, an [[Echani/Legends|Echani]] [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] from the planet [[Thyrsus/Legends|Thyrsus]], another of the Six Sisters.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

Though the uprising nominally ended with the return of Begali to the Six Sisters less than a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later, hostility between the [[Thyrsian]]s and Echani Command continued until the [[Pact of Almera]] in [[899 BBY]] recognized Thyrsian independence.<ref name="Author's Cut" />

The Begali Uprising was most well-known as being the event that introduced the use of [[Force pike/Legends|force pikes]] to galactic warfare.<ref name="Imperial Sourcebook">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
